checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics now separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging.
Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present.
Weathering is driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime; facade optics does not bake rain streaks, shadows or sky highlights into its base albedo.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, and a two-scale non-metallic facade coating. Clear glazing is a non-metallic premultiplied Transparent Standard material with non-emissive interior backing, replacing the old opaque blue-gray window rendering while retaining base colliders.
Solar direction/elevation context exists for coherent midsummer lighting.
Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics explicitly skips when the danchi authored-art slot is active.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with explicit foundation/grade and facade/glazing contracts. The glazing contract records construction, nominal pane thickness concept, IOR/F0 reference, roughness, transmission proxy, mounting/depth separation, forbidden responses and frontal/oblique/grazing lookdev criteria.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops now rebuilds and validates infrastructure microdetail, metric anti-repeat base ground, physical grade/contact interfaces, and facade/glazing optics before rendering.
Capture contract records exact view/crop paths and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it.
No actual Unity 6.3 editor/runner compile verification artifact exists yet.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Material/PBR physical plausibility: the old opaque blue-gray window block is hidden at render time and replaced by non-metallic premultiplied-transparent dielectric glazing over physically separated non-emissive backing; facade coating gains primary plus detail normal structure and bounded roughness variation.

Geometry/construction fidelity: apartment windows now expose two separate sliding pane planes with a 14 mm depth offset and a 180 mm backing depth, preserving the existing aluminum frame/track geometry instead of treating glazing as one 100 mm-thick cube.

Texture/microdetail: the hero facade gets deterministic 1024px tileable albedo/normal/smoothness plus a second detail-normal scale; the front-face tiling is derived from real facade dimensions to reduce giant-tile repetition in 4K crops.

Lighting/reflections: Standard Transparent mode retains specular reflection while alpha controls body transparency, so grazing response can come from the shader Fresnel/smoothness behavior rather than a painted highlight. No Visual Fidelity points are awarded until real hero/oblique/grazing renders demonstrate this.
Cinematic image quality: deterministic interior backing variation prevents every apartment opening from reading as the same black/blue void while remaining non-emissive in the daytime benchmark.
